```{r}
#| include: false
#| context: setup


## Packages
pacman::p_load(
  quarto,
  tidyverse, 
  DT, 
  lubridate,  
  reactable, 
  janitor, 
  forcats,
  plotly,
  htmltools
)

## Données
work_magnet_all <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("data", "work_magnet_all.parquet"))
su_structures <- rio::import(here::here("data", "su_structures.rds"))


## Information mises à jour
maj <- file.info(here::here("data", "work_magnet_all.parquet"))$mtime
maj <- as.Date(maj, format = "%Y-%m-%d")


## Préparation des données 
su_structures <- su_structures %>% unnest(display_name_acronyms)
su_structures <- su_structures %>% 
  distinct(across(-display_name_acronyms), .keep_all = TRUE)
su_structures <- su_structures %>% 
  mutate(display_name_acronyms = ifelse(
    !is.na(display_name_acronyms), 
    display_name_acronyms, 
    display_name))
su_structures <- su_structures %>% 
  separate(display_name_acronyms, into = "Acronymes", sep = ":")
work_magnet_su <- work_magnet_all %>% 
  filter(contact_domain == "sorbonne-universite.fr")

```

## Graphiques demandes soumises {width="50%"}



### {.tabset title="Demandes de corrections soumises (par mois)"}



```{r}
#| title: "2025"


monthly_breaks <- seq.Date(
  from = as.Date("2025-01-01"), 
  to = as.Date("2025-12-31"), 
  by = "months")


p <- work_magnet_su %>% 
  filter(year(date_opened) == 2025) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = date_opened) + 
  geom_histogram(
    breaks = monthly_breaks, 
    color = "white", 
    fill = "#1D2769") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 months",
    date_labels = "%b",
    expand = c(0, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

ggplotly(p)
```

### {.tabset } 



```{r}
#| title: "Demande de corrections par structures"
 
bar_chart <- function(label, width = "100%", height = "0.875rem", fill = "#00bfc4", background = NULL) {
  bar <- div(style = list(background = fill, width = width, height = height))
  chart <- div(style = list(flexGrow = 1, marginLeft = "0.375rem", background = background), bar)
  div(style = list(display = "flex", alignItems = "center"), label, chart)
}
  
work_magnet_su %>%  
  mutate(added_rors = str_remove(added_rors, pattern = "02en5vm52;")) %>% 
  mutate(added_rors = str_remove(added_rors, pattern = ";02en5vm52")) %>%  
  separate_rows(added_rors, sep = ";") %>% 
  filter(added_rors != "") %>% 
  left_join(su_structures, by = c("added_rors" = "ror")) %>% 
  mutate(Acronymes = ifelse(
    !is.na(Acronymes), 
    Acronymes, 
    added_rors)) %>% 
  count(Acronymes, state) %>%
  group_by(Acronymes) %>% 
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    closed = ifelse(any(state == "closed"), n[state == "closed"], 0),
    proportion = closed/sum(n)
  ) %>% 
  select(Acronymes, total, proportion)  %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    defaultSorted = "total",
    columns = list(
      Acronymes = colDef(
        name = "Structures de recherche"
      ),
      total = colDef(
        name = "Demandes de correction",
        defaultSortOrder = "desc",
        format = colFormat(separators = TRUE)
      ),
      proportion = colDef(
        name = "Cloturées",
        defaultSortOrder = "desc",
        cell = function(value) {
          value <- paste0(format(value * 100, digits = 2, nsmall = 1), "%")
          value <- format(value, width = 6, justify = "right")
          bar_chart(value, width = value, fill = "#076fa2", background = "#e1e1e1")
        },
        align = "left",
        style = list(fontFamily = "monospace", whiteSpace = "pre")
      )
    )
  )
```



```{r}
#| title: "Détail"


work_magnet_su %>% 
  filter(state == "open") %>% 
  mutate(date_closed = maj) %>% 
  mutate("Délai" = round(difftime(date_closed, date_opened, units = "days"))) %>% 
  mutate("Correction" = ifelse(has_added_rors == "1", "ror ajouté", "ror retiré")) %>% 
  mutate("Structure" = ifelse(has_added_rors == "1", added_rors, removed_rors)) %>% 
  left_join(su_structures, by = c("Structure" = "ror")) %>%
  mutate(Acronymes = str_glue("({Acronymes})")) %>% 
  unite("Structure", c("Structure", "Acronymes"), sep = " ") %>% 
  select(
    "Issue" = github_issue_link, 
    Structure,
    Correction,
    "Date d'ouverture" = date_opened,
    Délai
    ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Délai)) %>% 
  mutate(Délai = paste(Délai, "jours")) %>%
  reactable(
    striped = TRUE, 
    pagination = FALSE,
    showSortable = TRUE,
    searchable = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = colDef(align = "left"),
    columns = list(Issue = colDef(cell = function(value) {
      htmltools::tags$a(href = value, target = "_blank", as.character(value))
    }))
    )
```


## 



```{r}
#| title: "Répartition des demandes en fonction des délais de fermeture"
#| height: 80%

df <- work_magnet_su %>%
  filter(year(date_opened) == 2025) %>% 
  mutate(date_closed = as.Date(date_closed)) %>% 
  mutate(date_closed = if_else(is.na(date_closed), maj, date_closed)) %>% 
  mutate("Délai" = as.integer(round(difftime(date_closed, date_opened, units = "days"))))

p <- df %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = Délai) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(75), 
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(10), 
    expand = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

ggplotly(p)
```



```{r}

  
df %>% 
  rstatix::get_summary_stats(Délai) %>% 
  select("Délai" = variable, min, q1, median, mean, q3, max) %>% 
  mutate(Délai = recode(Délai, "Délai" = "jours")) %>% 
  reactable() 
```

```{r}
#| title: "Retrait de l'affiliation Sorbonne université"
#| height: "55%"


p <- work_magnet_all %>% 
  filter(grepl("02en5vm52", removed_rors)) %>% 
  count(contact_domain) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = fct_rev(fct_infreq(contact_domain, n)),
      x = n) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1D2769") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0, 0.1, 0),
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "")

ggplotly(p)
```

```{r}


work_magnet_all %>% 
  filter(grepl("02en5vm52", removed_rors)) %>% 
  separate_rows(openalex_works_examples, sep = ";") %>% 
  select(
    "Issue" = github_issue_link,
    "Structure" = removed_rors, 
    "Signature" = raw_affiliation_name,
    "Contacte" = contact_domain
    ) %>% 
  group_by(Issue, Structure, Signature, Contacte) %>% 
  summarise("Publications" = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Publications)) %>% 
  reactable(
    striped = TRUE, 
    pagination = FALSE,
    showSortable = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = colDef(align = "left"), 
    columns = list(Issue = colDef(cell = function(value) {
      htmltools::tags$a(href = value, target = "_blank", as.character(value))
    }))
    )
```

dataset %>%
